scope.purpose: Exact-name mechanics and Limit Burst refresh for high-impact PQ-linked thin records.

evidence.use: Maintained Xenoverse 2 Super Soul catalogue corroborates mechanics, characters, acquisition endpoints, and Limit Bursts for the selected records.
Maintained all-Parallel-Quest guide independently corroborates PQ137 rewards for Super Souls 220 and 221 and PQ138 rewards for Super Souls 222 and 223.
Independent discussion corroborates the gameplay roles of the selected PQ137/PQ138 Super Souls, including 221 and 223.
Independent documentation corroborates Super Soul 223's PQ138 acquisition and movement/stamina bonuses.

limits: Acquisition probabilities are not treated as mechanics evidence.
No Ultimate-Finish requirement was inferred or changed.
Super Soul 221's all-match persistence after its one-time activation is retained from maintained catalogue semantics; no numeric duration is invented.
